seo.title: Romantic Shillong Cherrapunji Tour Package of 6 Days and 5 Nights - Kajaawa
seo.description: Book our Romantic Shillong Cherrapunji Tour Package of 6 days, 5 Nights and enjoy a wonderful time in Meghalaya.

items: Hotel
Transportation
Breakfast

Sightseeing

content.text: Book our Romantic Shillong Cherrapunji Tour Package of 6 days 5 Nights. We will take you to the most beautiful places in Meghalaya. Spend precious moments in the midst of mountains in Cherrapunji. Enjoy the calmness of the breeze of the cleanst Umngot River while boating. Relax in the nature at the riveside campsite in Shnongpdeng. Explore all this and lot more in this tour with Kajaawa.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Experience the pleasures of boating on Umiam Lake
Get a feel for Shillong as you explore its beautiful hills and greenery
Cherrapunji and its amazing sites are on the agenda for a day trip
Visit Mawlynnong, Asia's cleanest village, and see the beautiful Umngot River
Enjoy a morning stroll at Laitlum Canyons
Visit Mawphlang Forest, and the Khasi Heritage Village

days.title: Day 1 : Guwahati Arrival – Shillong- A Romantic Start
items: Your arrival at the airport/railway station in Guwahati will be warmly welcomed by our staff.
Following that, you will proceed to Shillong.
You will be able to stop at Umiam Lake, a beautiful lake surrounded by Sylvan Hills.
In the evening, you are free to do whatever you like.

days.title: Day 2 : Shillong Tour
items: Continue your journey to Elephant Falls and Shillong Peak after breakfast.
You can also visit Ward's Lake and Botanical Garden.
Later in the evening, you can stroll in the market for shopping.

days.title: Day 3 : Cherrapunji Excursion – Wettest Place
items: On the third day, you will visit for a day excursion at Cherrapunji, the wettest place on earth.
On the way, you will visit Mawkdok Dympep Valley.
Later, in Cherrapunji you will witness beautiful falls like the Seven Sister Falls and Nohkalikai Falls. You will also witness the breathtaking Wei Sawdong Falls and the Dainthlen Falls.
Following a visit to Arwah Cave and the Mawsmai Cave.
Before the evening, you will visit the eco-park where you can spend time admiring the beauty of Cherrapunji’s Hill.

days.title: Day 4 : Shillong- Dawki & Mawlynnong
items: Early morning after breakfast starts your tour to the cleanest village in Asia, Mawlynnong.
Also, witness the Balancing Rock, a small rock balancing a big rock.
Visit the clear and clean river of Umngot in Dawki.
You can enjoy boating and while boating you can see the river bed from the surface.
In the evening we will take you to the campsite at Shnongpdeng.
Relax beside the river and enjoy a bonfire with your family or friends.

days.title: Day 5 : Laitlum Canyons and Mawphlang Sacred Forest
items: Have your breakfast and head to Laitlum for a morning stroll to its beautiful sites.
Spend your time admiring the beauty of the Grand Canyons.
Visit Mawphlang village and witness the Mawphlang forest together with the Khasi Heritage Village.

days.title: Day 6 : Return Journey
items: After a heartful breakfast, you will be dropped to Guwahati Airport/ Railway station.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7 (seven) business days in the customer's bank account.
